profile.headline: Software Engineer SMTS at CloudCraze a Salesforce company
profile.summary:
I am a Web UI developer pursuing my passion for creating cutting edge user interfaces. I have worked on a multitude of enterprise level projects delivering innovative widgets and dynamic views.

Specialties: Java, JavaScript, Dojo, CSS3, JSON, REST, HTML, XML, Ruby, C/C++, and Assembly.  Infrastructure automation via Chef. Scripting in UNIX, bash, batch, or vbscript. InstallShield, Installation Manager. RTC, and Agile Development. Java GUI Design (Swing and SWT/jface) Makefiles, and Mantis/ANT based build. Sockets Programming, RMI, Servlet and JSP. Fluent in Eclipse, Rational Software Development Platform, and possess strong written and verbal communications.

positions.title: Software Engineer SMTS
Product Developer
positions.description:
CloudCraze: Enterprise eCommerce built natively on the Salesforce platform
 
CloudCraze is a cloud ecommerce solution that is filling the void for agile and scalable cloud-based omni-channel commerce solutions. CloudCraze delivers enterprise-class B2B/B2C cross-channel eCommerce on Salesforce that is four times faster and one-fifth the cost of traditional ecommerce applications. The product is built natively on the Salesforce1 Platform so clients can deploy mobile storefronts quickly, generate online revenues in weeks, and easily scale for growth. 
 · CloudCraze was one of 8 firms recognized in The ForresterWave™: B2B Commerce Suites, Q2 2015.
· CloudCraze is a Platinum ISV Partner within the Salesforce Cloud Alliance Program.

company.name: CloudCraze: Enterprise eCommerce built natively on the Salesforce platform

positions.title: SCE+ Next Gen Software Developer, GTS
positions.description:
Developed and owned Chef based Ruby recipes for monitoring cloud managed service.
Provided guidance to get JSON based managed services payload design agreed and approved across the stack.
Provided education and guidance to my team on writing Chef recipes following best practices.

positions.title: Cloud Systems Software Web UI Developer, STG
positions.description:
Collaborated closely with the user experience team to design and then implement cutting edge UI designs.
Refactored multiple widgets and pages to comply with dojo 1.7 AMD, template, and style guidelines.
Converted JSF based UI panels to new dojo based widgets and views.
Interfaced with the REST API team to adjust UI code and negotiate changes to optimize the usefulness of the APIs within our views.
Provided defect fixes and design advice to internal teams using our UI framework.
Designed and implemented an advanced tagging widget to tag resources across multiple views.
Presented education materials to my teams about various emerging technologies.
Created designs for a UI to stand up multiple OpenStack based systems in a Software Defined Environment from bare metal driven by Chef recipes.
Drove resolution of many performance and scale issues, delivering innovative solutions for scaling up in the NextGen UI and legacy ISC Console environments.

positions.title: Tivoli Common Topology/VMControl/Systems Director Developer, STG
positions.description:
Owned and developed multiple dojo and JavaScript based widget components within Tivoli Common Topology.
Led the reengineering and development of TCT table views to a new dojo based table library.
Interfaced directly with internal customers and early adopters to provide new and modified function to better suit their design requirements. 
Designed and implemented a JMS driven notification framework throttled via a specialized queuing thread for zManager.
Key member of vmware and KVM virtualization based FVT test teams providing execution as well as leadership to help drive blockers through to resolution.
Mastered setting up complex Flex System Management environment to utilize for high scale performance testing.
Improved automation and setup scripts to aid in complex configuration for multiple systems.
Owned and exited multiple User Stories across release iterations.

positions.title: WebSphere Process Server Install Developer and Function Test Team Lead, SWG
positions.description:
Lead day to day Function Verification Test (FVT) test activities (test scope definition, test creation and approval, status tracking/reporting, etc) for China based team across multiple customer deliveries.
Created automated Unit Test code for multiple products within the Business Process Management stack.
Owned and exited multiple User Stories across release iterations.
Designed and implemented a cross product technology for prerequisite detection before the product is installed.
Developed eclipse based plugins for Installation Manager based offerings
Modified and created build code to enable publishing of cd images and customer required fixes.
Created silent installation scripts and templates in order to automate the multiple silent install steps into a single process for products in the BPM stack. 
Created and ran FVT tests on multiple platforms as well as authored and contributed to required specifications.
Designed/Implemented team wiki for both test and development use.

positions.title: DB2 Content Manager  Install Team Developer, SWG
positions.description:
Lead Installation developer for multiple Java components within the ECM product stack (e.g. Eclient, CM, II4C). The ECM product area is roughly a 300 million dollar revenue area.
Lead development for both GUI and non-GUI java components.
Primarily responsible for the cross-platform installation library which contains the unique code needed for each OS we support (Linux, AIX, Sun, Window's, and zLinux).
Developed and maintained the installation dependence detection logic, which detects and verifies that the products prerequisites are appropriate. This requires I work closely with other product groups like DB2 and WebSphere Application Server.
Assisted and participated in customer situations from presales to support engagements when required.
Created and ran FVT tests on multiple platforms as well as authored and contributed to required specifications.
Drove initiatives and new technology into our team, such as adopting Eclipse as our primary IDE to speed up development

positions.title: INROADS Intern, Install Design Team Member
positions.description:
Created test cases and scenarios for Install Function Verification Test
Created a bash script File Verification Tool for test automation 
Designed scripts to automate test cases by collecting output, determining the results, cleaning up  databases between tests, and packaged it into one interface
Ran tests on two separate products and opened up relevant defects

positions.title: INROADS Intern, Install Design Team Member
positions.description:
Drove debugging of critical DBCS Chinese enablement code
Set up test machines for overseas translators 
Assisted in troubleshooting the Japanese DBCS installment of the product
Created a version level program for DB2 Content Manager 8.2

positions.title: INROADS Intern, Install Design Team Member
positions.description:
Created and programmed panels for Install using ISMP
Adjusted layout of panels to enhance usability 
Programmed launch pad for install
Created test plan including cases and scenarios

positions.title: INROADS Intern, Function Test Team Member
positions.description:
Tested function of GUI elements
Created test cases and test scenarios 
Setup testing environment and Configured basic network properties
